key_decisions: NO code-signing certificate and NO NSIS installer. User decision, 2026-07-29. Signing does not fix SAC - it starts the reputation clock, it does not skip it. An unsigned root CubricVision.exe is the accepted outcome: it converts a hard block into standard SmartScreen with a 'More info -> Run anyway' path.

Windows-only branch. PLATFORM_CONFIG in build-portable.mjs carries appDirRel + electronRoot + exeName per platform; linux and darwin keep appDirRel 'app' and no electronRoot. A test pins this so a future 'tidy-up' cannot move Linux/macOS.

The Windows update .bat files were KEPT, not deleted. SAC blocks them, but the in-app update button no longer goes through them - main.js spawns update/win-update.cjs via process.execPath with ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1. The .bat is a second entry point onto the same file for machines where SAC is off. One implementation.

app/ is deliberately NOT in RETIRED_PATHS. The applier that runs a transition update is the user's OLD one, executing app/node_modules/electron/dist/electron.exe as node, and Windows cannot delete a running image - rmSync throws EBUSY and aborts everything. The stale app/ tree is left on disk and the release note tells the user it is safe to delete.
MPI-387 is an UMBRELLA card. D landing did NOT close it.
Release base is still PARKED. master is well ahead of v1.2.0 and is not a patch. No branch has been created.
constraints: DO NOT reintroduce a Windows start script, not even as a convenience alongside the exe. SAC blocks it on exactly the machines that need it.
THE .lnk ROUTE IS DEAD (stores an absolute path) and THE EXTRACTION-RACE THEORY IS DEAD (the captured log disproves it). Both settled with evidence; do not re-propose.
THE UPDATE ARCHIVE NAME IS FROZEN (MPI-369) - shipped updaters glob CubricVision-<platform>-<arch>-update-v*.zip by name.
THE WINDOWS FULL ZIP MUST STAY ROOTLESS (includeRoot: opts.platform !== 'win32'). Re-adding an inner root re-breaks a default Downloads extract by 32 characters.
ENGINE ROOT BUDGET IS 89 CHARS on Windows. The relayout did not change it: the deepest app-relative path measures 107, so resources/app tops out at 121 against the engine's binding 171.

A VERIFICATION BUILD HAS TWO SIDE EFFECTS ON THE TRACKED TREE. Pass --no-source-manifest or it overwrites resources/cubric/update-manifest.json with a ~32k-line diff. And a non-dry-run build needs docs/releases/.approved-<version>.json, which is a TRACKED file that `ls` does not show - do not delete it. Both are written up in the contract doc; both were hit this session.

SHARED TREE.
